changelog: 1.0.0.0: Initial release with configurable watch threshold and skip cooldown, per-user private playlists, auto-dedupe, cleanup, playlist-only skipping, auto-reset, and progress display on the plugin page and native playlist details (via JavaScript Injector).
description: Only plays unwatched videos from a dedicated playlist, tracks progress with configurable thresholds, and resets the cycle once everything has been played.
name: Smart Shuffle Playlist
overview: A smart shuffle playlist that tracks played items and skips videos that have already been watched.
